where: Section 2 (Publish your file with FileProvider) and worked example 1, step 1
problem: The <provider> tag is described without the <meta-data> child that points to res/xml/file_paths.xml. Without it FileProvider has no configured roots, so getUriForFile throws IllegalArgumentException ("Failed to find configured root that contains ...") and the whole worked example fails.
fix: Inside the <provider> tag add: <meta-data android:name="android.support.FILE_PROVIDER_PATHS" android:resource="@xml/file_paths" />. State that this line is what connects the provider to file_paths.xml, and add it to step 1 of the worked example.

problem: "Putting a File in EXTRA_STREAM creates a file:// URI" is wrong. A File object is not a URI; putting it in EXTRA_STREAM just gives the receiver an unusable value. FileUriExposedException comes from putting a file:// URI in the intent.
fix: "Passing a file:// URI (for example Uri.fromFile(file)) in EXTRA_STREAM, or as the intent data, throws FileUriExposedException on Android 7 (API 24) and later. Always pass the content:// URI from FileProvider instead."

where: Section 1, sentence "Always set the type before putting extras; the chooser reads it."
problem: The order of setType() and putExtra() does not matter, so the rule as written teaches a non-rule. The real order trap is between setData() and setType(), which clear each other.
fix: "Set the MIME type with setType() so Android can match receivers; putExtra() later does not change it. Do not call setData() after setType(), because setData() clears the type (and setType() clears the data)."
